title: Baryonic mass budgets in the central regions of the Bullet Cluster and their consistency with strong lensing in MOND (Zhang, Haghi, Asencio, Banik, Hasani Zonoozi et al.)
efc_relevance: Re-estimates the baryonic masses of the three BCG-centred core regions of the Bullet Cluster and compares them with MOND strong-lensing masses, arguing that stellar-remnant baryons from a past top-heavy IMF can substantially close — though not eliminate — the residual missing-mass gap exposed in arXiv:2605.10022. Direct fourth-independent input to EFC's sealed JWST Bullet δκ shock-front prediction (figshare 31963668), and shifts the MOND-vs-EFC discriminator by re-locating part of the 'missing' mass into the baryon column rather than the gravity sector.
ledger_action: Add to Validation Ledger as Bullet δκ baryon-budget probe; promote Stage-IV Roadmap Bullet pipeline (already prioritised by arXiv:2605.10022); update framework:MOND-Milgrom1983 and framework:VerlindeEmergent-2016 rows with the baryon-remnant caveat; cross-reference arXiv:2503.21870, arXiv:2601.22245 and arXiv:2606.05298 (cluster lensing systematic).
